name: Ashen Executioner
description: Bleeds you inflict also Ignite for 40% of their damage.
flavour: It did not stop at the neck. The ash did the rest.

name: Chrono-Spindle Focus
description: Completing a Cast-Bar spell triggers a free Weapon Auto-Attack.
flavour: It remembers the swing you have not made yet.

name: Prismatic Aegis
description: All sockets become White. Each socketed gem grants +18 Max Ward.
flavour: Every colour of the world, ground into one pane.

name: Venomfang Stiletto
description: Poison (Corruption) stacks have no cap and tick 25% faster.
flavour: The venom does not dilute. It accumulates.

name: Soul-Furnace Plate
description: 30% of your Armor also mitigates Elemental and Void damage.
flavour: The furnace does not care what it eats, only that it burns.

name: Wraithbone Crown
description: Deal 25% more damage to Chilled or Frozen enemies.
flavour: Worn by something that never needed a face.

name: Emberheart Censer
description: When a Burning enemy dies, its Ignite spreads to the next enemy at full stacks.
flavour: Ash is only fire that has learned patience.

name: Mirror of the Hollow Choir
description: 20% of damage taken is refunded as Ward.
flavour: It sings back your wounds in a different key.

name: Titan's Ledger
description: Every 1% Armor Break grants +0.5% Critical Multiplier.
flavour: Debts of iron are always paid in blood.

name: Thornbound Gauntlets
description: Gain Thorns equal to 30% of your Armor.
flavour: Every grip is a promise to hold on.

name: Riftwalker Treads
description: Each dodge grants +10% Attack Speed for 3 seconds, stacking up to 4.
flavour: Step where the world is thin.

name: Cowl of the Last Spark
description: Deal 30% more damage while below 35% Life.
flavour: The last spark burns brightest because it has nothing left to lose.
